items.title: Halogenoalkanes: Introduction and Classification (ta'aruf aur qismein) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chapter opening, halothane and the classes of halogenoalkanes, printed pages 72-73.

blocks.text: Halogenoalkanes rozmarra zindagi mein bohat kaam ke hain, khaas taur par apni khaas chemical stability (mazbooti) ki wajah se. Pehle chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) refrigerants (thanda karne wali cheezein) aur aerosol propellants (spray ko bahar dhakelne wali gas) ke taur par istemal hote the, lekin ab in ki jagah eco-friendly (mahol ke liye behtar) alternatives (doosre options) aa rahe hain. Medicine (dawa) mein halogenated compounds powerful (taqatwar) anesthetic (behosh karne wali dawa) ka kaam karte hain. Is ke ilawa yeh polymers banane mein bohat zaroori intermediates (beech mein banne wali cheezein) hain, jaise pipes ke liye PVC (polyvinyl chloride) aur non-stick cookware (bartanon) ke liye PTFE (Teflon).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke CFCs ki jagah 'Freons' jaise eco-friendly alternatives aa rahe hain. Lekin Freon khud CFCs ka trade name (company ka rakha hua naam) hai, maslan Freon-12 = CCl₂F₂. CFCs ki jagah asal mein HFCs (hydrofluorocarbons) jaise compounds aa rahe hain jin mein chlorine nahi hoti.

blocks.alt: Halothane ka displayed structure (sab bonds dikhane wala): aik carbon jis par teen F atoms (left, oopar, neeche), doosre carbon se jura jis par oopar Cl, neeche H aur right par Br hai.
blocks.caption: Structure of halothane (kitab ke PDF page 76 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Halothane ek halogenated hydrocarbon hai jo inhalation (saans ke zariye diya jane wala) powerful anesthetic hai. Yeh operation (surgery) ke dauran aisi behoshi lata hai jo baad mein khatam ho jati hai (reversible). Pehle chloroform aur doosre chlorinated anesthetics istemal hote the, lekin ab yeh toxic (zehreele) hone aur safety (hifazat) ke masle ki wajah se band (banned) hain.

Jab kisi alkane ke ek ya zyada hydrogen atoms ki jagah halogen atoms aa jayein to halogenoalkane banta hai. Molecule mein halogen atoms (–X) kitne hain, is ke mutabiq yeh mono, di, tri ya poly halogenoalkanes kehlate hain.

blocks.alt: Teen displayed structures, har aik mein carbon ke left H aur right X: monohalogenoalkane (oopar neeche H), dihalogenoalkane (oopar X, neeche H) aur trihalogenoalkane (oopar neeche X).
blocks.caption: Mono-, di- aur trihalogenoalkanes (kitab ke PDF page 76 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: In mein se monohalogenoalkanes ko alkyl halides bhi kehte hain. In ka general formula R – X hai; R methyl, ethyl, propyl waghera ho sakta hai aur X halogen atom (F, Cl, Br, I) hai. Monohalogenoalkanes ko phir primary, secondary aur tertiary mein classify (qismon mein baanta) kiya jata hai. Yeh is par depend karta hai ke halogen jis carbon par laga hai, woh carbon kitne doosre carbons se jura hai.
Primary halogenoalkane mein halogen aise carbon se jura hota hai jo aage sirf ek carbon atom se jura ho, ya kisi carbon se na jura ho, maslan:

blocks.alt: Teen primary halogenoalkanes boxes mein: CH3-Cl chloromethane, CH3-CH2-Cl chloroethane aur CH3-CH2-CH2-Cl 1-chloropropane.
blocks.caption: Primary halogenoalkanes ki misalein (kitab ke PDF page 76 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Secondary halogenoalkanes woh hain jin mein halogen wala carbon seedha do doosre carbon atoms se jura ho.

blocks.alt: 2-chloropropane: do CH3 groups CH-Cl se jure; aur 2-chlorobutane, CH3-CH(Cl)-CH2-CH3, jis mein Cl doosre carbon ke oopar hai.
blocks.caption: Secondary halogenoalkanes ki misalein (kitab ke PDF page 76 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Tertiary halogenoalkane mein halogen wala carbon seedha teen doosre carbon atoms se jura hota hai.

blocks.alt: 2-chloro-2-methylpropane: central (beech wala) carbon jis ke right Cl, left H3C aur oopar neeche CH3 hain.
blocks.caption: Tertiary halogenoalkane ki misal (kitab ke PDF page 76 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Pehchan ka asaan tareeqa: X wale carbon ke saath kitne carbon jure hain, gin lein. 0 ya 1 carbon = primary (1°), 2 carbons = secondary (2°), 3 carbons = tertiary (3°).

blocks.explanation: 1-chloro-2-methylpropane. Sab se lambi chain mein 3 carbons hain, Cl carbon 1 par aur methyl group carbon 2 par hai. Cl wala carbon (CH₂) sirf ek carbon se jura hai, is liye yeh primary chloride hai.

blocks.prompt: b) C₅H₁₁Cl formula ke tamam structures banayein aur har ek ko primary, secondary ya tertiary chloride batayein.
blocks.explanation: Aath (8) structures hain. Primary: CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₂CH₂Cl (1-chloropentane), ClCH₂CH(CH₃)CH₂CH₃ (1-chloro-2-methylbutane), (CH₃)₂CHCH₂CH₂Cl (1-chloro-3-methylbutane), (CH₃)₃CCH₂Cl (1-chloro-2,2-dimethylpropane). Secondary: CH₃CHClCH₂CH₂CH₃ (2-chloropentane), CH₃CH₂CHClCH₂CH₃ (3-chloropentane), (CH₃)₂CHCHClCH₃ (2-chloro-3-methylbutane). Tertiary: (CH₃)₂CClCH₂CH₃ (2-chloro-2-methylbutane).

items: Halogenoalkane: alkane ke H ki jagah halogen (F, Cl, Br, I); halogens ki ginti (number) se mono, di, tri, poly.
X wale carbon ke saath 0 ya 1 C = primary, 2 C = secondary, 3 C = tertiary.
